explanation: A symbol of Jesus Christ as the sacrifice for humanity's sins, represented as a slain yet living animal with seven horns and seven eyes.
A parchment scroll containing God's plan for world history and judgment upon the earth, sealed with seven seals.
Seven symbolic seals on the book representing the seven major events or judgments in end-time prophecies.
The concept of being worthy to open the book and reveal its contents, made possible only by the Lamb's sacrifice.
The heavenly praise sung by the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders to glorify God's power and the Lamb.
An expression for all nations, tribes, and languages who are bought into freedom through the blood of the Lamb.
The eternal kingdom where the saved will reign with Christ on earth for a thousand years or in the new creation.
